cat > /work/ecb.md <<'EOF'
On 30 January 2025 the ECB cut its three key rates by 25bp, lowering the deposit facility rate to 2.75% (main refinancing 2.90%, marginal lending 3.15%) from 5 February.
It was the fourth consecutive cut, decided unanimously; the ECB says disinflation is "well on track" and policy remains restrictive, with growth set to stay weak near term.
Guidance stays data-dependent and meeting-by-meeting with no pre-commitment to a rate path; the next meeting is 6 March 2025.
EOF
